Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the quick intro. We’re excited to see Redwood’s latency/cost story in action. Our execs want a short, focused briefing ahead of the demo next month so they can vet the architecture and ask a few platform-level questions. Ideally we’d have a VP or the CTO join for the first 20 minutes to cover compliance, deployment options, and run-rate economics.

Two windows that work for our team (PDT):
- Tue Jul 28, 10:00–10:40 AM PDT
- Wed Jul 29, 8:30–9:10 AM PDT

Attached is a short MAP and requirements doc (Zephyrus-MAP-v1.pdf) that lists the areas we care about. Can you confirm if Redwood can commit VP/CTO level presence for one of those windows or whether a senior engineering sponsor + a product lead is the realistic option?

We’re trying to lock the briefing by Wednesday so our CTO (Sarah) can join.

Thanks,
Tom Han
Head of Platforms

- Is Sarah primarily interested in architecture at scale (networking/KMS) or data governance/use-case limits?
- Do you want us to prepare a 10-slide CTO-Focused appendix (concise SLOs, deploy modes, private options)?

On times: Wed Jul 29 at 8:30 AM PDT is feasible for our side. Tue Jul 28 at 10:00 AM conflicts with an org review; we’d prefer Wed if that still works. If not, we can run Tue and I’ll ask a director to stand in.

Marissa — can you send a calendar hold for Wed 29 08:30–09:10 PDT and attach the quick appendix draft?

Thanks,
